title: Minimum Sufficient Transparency (MST): code and data
description: Code and data for the article "Enough, but No More: Minimum Sufficient Transparency for Human Oversight of Multi-Agent Systems" (submitted to Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems). Includes the Python implementation of Exact-MST, Dynamic Greedy-MST and Progressive-MST, the frozen benchmark results, analysis notebooks, summary tables, figures, and the SARL multi-agent execution.
